title: Asset
description: Physical machine, installation or real production workplace. measurements reference assetCode.

assetCode.description: Stable business key, e.g. 'LOH-01591' (plant of origin + number); Process Data measurements.machine refers to it. Never changes, also not on a transfer.

plantId.description: Plant where the asset is now (plants@1).

sapReferences.description: SAP keys, unchanged (MD-04): {costObject: {type: 'cc'|'wbs', number}, workCenterNumber, equipmentNumber}. costObject is where maintenance time and material are booked.

attributes.description: Further values by field key; meaning, unit, list and applicability per type and plant are defined in equipment_fields@1.

originPlantId.description: Plant where the record was created; stays after a transfer (plantId is the current plant).

isActive.description: False once decommissioned or scrapped; never delete.

legacyId.description: Id in the previous system (Power App list item), for migration and lookup.

updatedBy.description: Person id (persons@1) of the last change.
